uniqueness_checks.name: 存在意義の一貫性
uniqueness_checks.description: 全MDで同じmissionが表現されているか
uniqueness_checks.evidence: All MD files consistently state the mission: 'GuiAgentLoopCore provides the core logic for bridging GUI frameworks and LLM agents, managing conversation flow, agent interactions, and state control.'

uniqueness_checks.name: 対象ユーザーの一貫性
uniqueness_checks.description: 全MDで同じtarget_userを想定しているか
uniqueness_checks.evidence: All MD files consistently reference the same target users: Application Developers, AI Agent Developers, Framework Developers, AI Agents

uniqueness_checks.name: 制約の一貫性
uniqueness_checks.description: 技術的制約が一致しているか
uniqueness_checks.evidence: Python version constraint (>=3.10) consistently documented across all MD files

uniqueness_checks.name: 境界線の一貫性
uniqueness_checks.description: out_of_scopeが矛盾なく定義されているか
uniqueness_checks.evidence: All MD files consistently define out_of_scope: UI Rendering, LLM Execution, Session Storage, Authentication, Network Protocols

uniqueness_checks.name: intent.yml準拠
uniqueness_checks.description: 全MDがintent.ymlを正しく反映しているか
uniqueness_checks.evidence: All core functions, boundaries, and design philosophy from intent.yml are accurately reflected in all MD files
